Incident Creation Agent queries Qdrant for duplicate detection.
Orchestrator writes Jira issue embeddings to Qdrant during the RAG sync.
Orchestrator reads Jira issues over the Jira REST API to keep the RAG store in sync.

Feishu Project automation rules call the orchestrator webhook when a story reaches test-ready status.

orchestrator-api-key.description: Webhook requests must carry a valid X-API-Key header; the orchestrator rejects requests with missing or incorrect keys.

config.name: Orchestrator API Key
config.description: Inbound webhook calls are authenticated with a shared API key.

relationships.description: Feishu Project's native workflow-status-change automation ("send HTTP request" action) calls the orchestrator's requirement-review webhook when a story enters the requirement-design status. This automation action cannot attach custom headers, so the endpoint is intentionally unauthenticated; abuse is bounded instead by an in-memory per-work-item dedup window and a global submission rate cap (REQUIREMENT_REVIEW_DEDUP_WINDOW_SECONDS / REQUIREMENT_REVIEW_MAX_PER_MINUTE).
Requirements Review Agent posts review feedback as a comment on the reviewed Feishu Project work item via the Feishu Project Open API.

meego-plugin-token.description: Requests to the Feishu Project Open API are authenticated with a plugin_token obtained from MEEGO_PLUGIN_ID and MEEGO_PLUGIN_SECRET.
